selected.title: DNB to lay off 400 and expand use of AI agents
selected.summary: Norway's biggest bank, DNB, is set to lay off 400 staff in its technology teams while it increases its investment in AI agents.
selected.why: Major strategic workforce reduction directly tied to replacing bank tech staff with AI agents.

reason: DNB's AI layoffs raise contestable claims about automation's true productivity gains and whether banks are solving real problems or chasing fashionable tech
angle: Banks replacing workers with AI agents may be pursuing automation theatre rather than genuine efficiency when the productivity case remains unproven.
